2608.25251.title: What Do Medical Vision-Language Models Learn in Radiology? Transfer, Alignment, and Source-Proxy Leakage Under Distribution Shift
2608.25251.paper_summary: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) can appear reliable in-domain while failing when acquisition domain, paired supervision, or evaluation protocol changes. We study this failure mode as a representation-level blind spot relevant to epistemic intelligence, without claiming a formal estimator of epistemic uncertainty. Using NIH ChestXray14 and CheXpert, we first isolate source-only cross-dataset visual transfer from unsupervised domain-adaptation diagnostics. Using PadChest and OpenI, we then evaluate multimodal alignment under strict pair-index retrieval and quantify metadata-derived source-proxy information retained in frozen embeddings. Self-supervised visual initialization improves NIH-to-CheXpert transfer over supervised ImageNet initialization in matched ResNet-18 comparisons, whereas adversarial adaptation is useful only in a narrow regime and becomes unstable as adversarial pressure increases. Multimodal exact-pair retrieval remains low under external OpenI stress testing, and source-proxy information remains recoverable from learned representations. Qualitative nearest-neighbor and Grad-CAM analyses show clinically plausible cross-dataset structure and thoracic attention patterns in many cases, while device-heavy and false-positive cases remain ambiguous. Auxiliary architecture checks are task-dependent and do not support a universal backbone ranking. Overall, the study shows that apparent competence under a single protocol can conceal transfer, alignment, and shortcut-related failure modes, motivating stress-tested evaluation of medical VLMs under distribution shift.
2608.25251.paper_summary_zh: 醫療視覺語言模型（VLMs）在特定領域中看似可靠，但當獲取領域、配對監督或評估協議改變時，便會失效。我們研究這種失效模式，將其視為與認識智能相關的表徵層盲點，而不聲稱有一個正式的認識不確定性估計器。使用NIH ChestXray14和CheXpert，我們首先將僅來源的跨數據集視覺轉移與無監督領域適應診斷分離。接著使用PadChest和OpenI，我們在嚴格的配對索引檢索下評估多模態對齊，並量化在凍結嵌入中保留的元數據衍生來源代理信息。自我監督的視覺初始化在與監督的ImageNet初始化相比的匹配ResNet-18比較中，改善了NIH到CheXpert的轉移，而對抗適應僅在狹窄範圍內有用，並隨著對抗壓力的增加而變得不穩定。在外部OpenI壓力測試下，多模態精確配對檢索仍然較低，且來源代理信息仍可從學習的表徵中恢復。定性最近鄰和Grad-CAM分析顯示，在許多情況下，臨床上合理的跨數據集結構和胸腔注意模式，而設備繁重和假陽性案例則仍然模糊。輔助架構檢查是任務依賴的，並不支持普遍的骨幹排名。總體而言，這項研究顯示，在單一協議下表面上的能力可能掩蓋轉移、對齊和捷徑相關的失效模式，促使對醫療VLMs在分佈變化下進行壓力測試評估。
